text: APPROVE: Removing the four catch clauses from the loop drops the cognitive complexity from 17 to about 13, and `TryList` keeps the same eager enumeration, catch types and skip-on-failure `continue` flow, so behaviour is unchanged. I did not build it, so the "warnings are errors" condition is judged from reading only (the `?` annotation assumes nullable context is enabled, and the `CHA0004` suppression is carried over into the helper).
